title: Professional Certificate Course in Introduction to Economic Theories and Models
description: Dive into the evolutionary journey of economic theories, tracing their roots from classical to neoclassical paradigms, and their adaptation in response to economic crises.
longDescription: This course provides an in-depth exploration of the development of economic theories over time. Participants will examine the theoretical foundations of classical economics, including the contributions of Adam Smith and David Ricardo. Additionally, participants will explore how neoclassical theories evolved in response to economic downturns, highlighting the concepts of marginal utility analysis. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following, ⦁ Understand that how economic theories have developed over time . ⦁ Obtain understanding of the theoretical foundations of classical economics, which can be traced back to individuals such as Adam Smith and David Ricardo. ⦁ Examine Alfred Marshall's contributions and the significance of marginal analysis and utility maximization. ⦁ Get an understanding of how neoclassical theories were altered in response to great depression in the economy. ⦁ Examine the environment in which neoclassical created the theories, highlighting the concepts of marginal utility analysis.
courseDetails: Participants will gain a comprehensive understanding of the evolution of economic theories, from classical to neoclassical paradigms. By delving into the historical context and theoretical foundations, participants will develop a nuanced understanding of economic theory and its implications for policy.
